title: AgentLeak: privacy-leakage testing for agentic AI systems
description: AgentLeak audits complete AI-agent execution traces for privacy leakage across eight instrumented channels (user input, tool responses and calls, shared memory, inter-agent messages, logs, generated files, final output), scores disclosures with AgentRisk, reconstructs source-to-target provenance and enforces release policies through an SDK, CLI, web workspace, MCP server, GitHub Action and sampled monitor. Version 0.18.0 is the version described and evaluated in the revised SoftwareX article; it fixes Presidio false positives and silent degradation, the monitor alert lifecycle, framework adapter capture and analysis scaling, and moves the source to src/.
notes: Release 0.18.0. Bundled PrivacyLens-derived fixtures are CC BY 4.0 and AgentDojo-derived fixtures MIT, with per-pack provenance; AgentLeak-authored code is MIT.
